# Wholesale MCP connectors

1 wholesale connector for AnythingMCP. Each one gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini the MCP tools of one system, on [AnythingMCP Cloud](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com) or on your own server ([run it yourself](../../README.md#run-it-yourself)).

Each connector's page lists its tools with their parameters and how to start without code; the guide links open the setup guide on anythingmcp.com, in seven languages. All wholesale connectors: [anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/wholesale](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/wholesale).

| Connector | What it does | Tools | Setup guides |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Oxomi Product & Media Portal](connectors/oxomi.md) | Look up product data, datasheets, documents, brands, media and availability via the official Oxomi Public API. | 10 | [Guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/oxomi-to-mcp) · [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-oxomi-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-oxomi-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-oxomi-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-oxomi-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-oxomi-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-oxomi-to-muse) |
